description: This is a C# ASP.NET Core controller for managing orders in an e-commerce backend. It includes endpoints for retrieving all orders, retrieving a specific order by ID, and creating new orders, utilizing Entity Framework Core for data access.

classes.name: OrdersController
classes.description: ASP.NET Core API controller for handling order-related HTTP requests.

classes.name: CreateOrderDto
classes.description: Data transfer object for creating a new order, containing customer email and list of items.

classes.name: CreateOrderItemDto
classes.description: Data transfer object representing a line item in a new order, specifying product ID and quantity.

methods.name: GetOrders
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all orders, including their order items and associated products.

methods.name: GetOrder
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific order by ID, including its order items and products.

methods.name: CreateOrder
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new order, updating stock levels and calculating total price.
